## Problem and intended user

Describe the need without private operational details.

## Proposed behavior

State affected platforms and components, threat model assumptions and alternatives.

## Acceptance criteria

Define measurable results and what requires installed-host or independent review.
Do not assume a lab result proves real-world censorship resistance.
